parameters.name: PasswordForcedUpdateStatus
parameters.description:
The password forced update status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationNotificationChannels
parameters.description: The list of password initialization notification channels.

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationStatus
parameters.description:
The password initialization configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationType
parameters.description:
The password initialization method. This parameter is required when PasswordInitializationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
- random: Random.
